label: Official UNIQLO body-size chart — not garment measurements.
title: UNIQLO US men’s and unisex tops — Size Guide, Body Size tab (inches)

evidence.what: Sweat Pullover Hoodie (unisex): Size Guide, Body Size tab
Sweatshirt (men): Size Guide, Body Size tab
SUPIMA® Cotton T-Shirt (unisex): Size Guide, Body Size tab

provenance: Not a page of its own. UNIQLO’s Body Size tab says its values “are body size measurements that correspond with a product’s size”, and the three US tops above publish it identically, size for size. Fynd copied each from its product page into the records named; the loader refuses this chart if any of them stops agreeing with it.
notes: Each product page’s Body Size table also has a second, unlabelled column (probably waist); it was never recorded, so it isn’t shown.
The sizes are the chart’s. A product using it may be sold in fewer of them.

products.name: Sweat Oversized Pullover Hoodie
products.identity: The product’s name and line are from UNIQLO’s listing title as shown in search results (“UNIQLO Men’s Sweat Oversized Pullover Hoodie”, assets/demo/demo-recording.json) and from the product’s owner; Fynd has not read its product page. Its own Size Guide has not been copied, so this general chart is used only when that page can’t be read.

tried: Fynd’s deployed server: uniqlo.com does not answer its requests.
GitHub’s runners (.github/workflows/uniqlo-catalog.yml): www.uniqlo.com reset every request, robots.txt included.
Fynd’s development environment, 19 October 2026: its network policy refuses www.uniqlo.com and image.uniqlo.com.
Web search, 19 October 2026: the indexed copies of this page carry only the Size Guide’s Body Size text (chest ranges), no Product Size table.
UNIQLO publishes no product or size-chart API; Fynd does not call its site’s internal commerce backend.
